attestations.text: CH'IEN Tsêng 錢曾 (T. 遵王, H. 也是翁), 1629–after 1699, bibliophile, was a native of Ch'ang-shu, Kiangsu, a descendant in the twenty-fifth generation of Ch'ien Liu 錢鏐 (852–932), founder of the state of Wu-Yüeh, one of the so-called "Ten Kingdoms" which arose during the transitional period between the T'ang and Sung dynasties.
